description: List the pictures, clips and songs saved in the linked account (clips kept with save_clip too), with the asset ids edit_video and create_video take in asset_ids. To bring in a new file, use import_asset; for videos, list_videos.
name: list_assets

outputSchema.description: Clypmint list_assets result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: List reusable media
